posts.text: After the 1982 World Series, my dad vowed to never allow Budweiser into his house (or his liver). Craft preferable, Miller acceptable. Sponsorship means MLB has teams use Budweiser, but I can only imagine what my dad was thinking as he watched his Brewers celebrate with Bud
